variables.input:
fetch bizevents //, scanLimitGBytes: 500, samplingRatio: 1000
| filter event.type=="netflow"
| parse `netflow.content`, """LD:netflow.date ' ' LD:netflow.time ' ' LD:netflow.status ' ' LD:netflow.message ' '{0,500} IPADDR:netflow.src.ip ':' LONG:netflow.src.port ' '{0,500}'->' ' '{0,500} IPADDR:netflow.dest.ip ':' LONG:netflow.dest.port ' '{0,500} IPADDR:netflow.xsrc.ip ':' LONG:netflow.xsrc.port ' '{0,500}'->' ' '{0,500} IPADDR:netflow.xdest.ip ':' LONG:netflow.xdest.port ' '{0,500} LONG:netflow.in.bytes ' '{0,500} LONG:netflow.out.bytes EOF"""
| parse `netflow.message`, """LD ('TCP'|'UDP'):netflow.protocol"""
| filterOut isNull(netflow.date)
| summarize count=count(), by:{`Source IP`=toString(netflow.src.ip)}
| sort count desc
| fields `Source IP`
